name: Dyed in White
storyline:
In a class-based society like the North Aura Kingdom, a lowborn Hayato must rise to protect his village. Alongside his childhood friend Leia, he trains to become a Holy Knight—but other men’s desires threaten her purity.

Will you be able to achieve your goal and protect Leia? Or will you let someone else win her over? It is up to you to decide what fate awaits them at the end of their intense story in this NTR RPG.
summary: A laid-back NTR RPG with a thrilling story and multiple endings. As Hayato, pursue becoming a Holy Knight alongside beautiful Leia. Delve into her deepest thoughts and shield her from other men. Can you protect her purity in a world full of temptation?
